A rejection with undefined has no Go form, because a nil error is success. Go mapping: StartSpan blocks until its callback returns; a rejection is the callback's returned error, compared by identity as strictEqual does; an awaited rejection arrives from another goroutine; the unreadable thrown value is an error whose Error method panics; a synchronous throw is also checked as a panic that the recorder settles and re-raises with the same value; the concurrent first child is a goroutine the parent joins. Source fix: the recorder stored nil (undefined) attribute values and let them overwrite recorded values; copyAttributes now omits them, as memory.ts copyAttributes/mergeAttributes do (red on 'recording › merges attributes and records ordered events').
